summary_brief: 2026年5月9日，AI Agent生态从"多Agent生产化"（May 6开启）进入"企业渗透+三层架构成熟"新阶段。最大突破：SAP企业采纳MCP协议——这是历史上首次大型企业软件巨头将MCP纳入主流工作流，标志着该协议从开发者工具正式进入生产级企业应用层。与此同时，多智能体协作编排（微软Magentic、OpenAI Codex远程控制、Opencode Scout研究代理）和评测基础设施（gptme A/B测试框架）双双成为平台竞争焦点。学术界lesson injection"交叉效应"研究则是新出现的第四层——科学验证基础，表明Agent上下文管理正从工程直觉走向可量化的条件化自适应。今日23条信号（高影响10条/43.5%），信号密度有所回落但质量显著提升，叙事重心从"安全债务清偿"切换为"企业落地+科学验证"双驱动。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 协议企业级采纳加速
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: SAP 作为企业软件巨头采纳 MCP 协议，标志着该协议正在进入企业主流应用开发工作流，将推动更广泛的 MCP 生态繁荣。

engineering_signals.title: OAuth PKCE 简化 LLM 提供商接入门槛
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 通过 PKCE 流程实现无 API key 的 OAuth 认证，用户从安装到可用实现真正的开箱即用，大幅降低 AI Agent 的配置复杂度。

engineering_signals.title: 多智能体协作编排成为平台竞争焦点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 微软 Magentic Orchestration、OpenAI Codex 远程控制、Scout 研究代理等新功能密集推出，表明多智能体协作正成为 AI Agent 平台差异化竞争的核心方向。

engineering_signals.title: 计划-执行分离架构优化推理模型使用成本
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 通过 Architect/Editor 分离模式解决强推理模型编辑能力弱的问题，实现质量与成本的平衡，为高效利用前沿模型提供工程范式。

engineering_signals.title: 统一凭证管理框架降低多提供商配置复杂度
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: credentials.toml + /account setup 命令为多 AI 提供商提供统一配置入口，简化环境变量管理，提升用户配置体验。

engineering_signals.title: 模型感知工具路由优化代码生成质量
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 基于 edit-format 偏好字段的智能路由使工具能选择各模型擅长的编辑格式，结合 12+ 月 Aider 实证数据，是低成本的代码质量提升方案。

engineering_signals.title: 沙箱安全边界变更要求迁移
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Agents Python 沙箱本地源物化限制在 base_dir 内，关闭本地工件边界漏洞，这是需要迁移的 Breaking Change，影响所有沙箱应用。

engineering_signals.title: 评测基础设施支持科学 A/B 测试
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 通过 --no-lessons 基线运行能力和 Pass-rate 门控机制，评测框架能够精确评估上下文注入的实际效果，为 AI Agent 优化提供数据支撑。

engineering_signals.title: 测试隔离最佳实践提升 CI 稳定性
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 使用 monkeypatch.delenv 清除环境变量确保测试在任意环境下可靠运行，体现测试隔离的最佳工程实践。

research_signals.title: Lesson Injection 交叉效应研究
research_signals.why_it_matters: 研究发现 structured_process 任务受益于 lessons 但 creative_restructuring 任务反而受损，揭示了 lesson injection 机制的条件依赖性，为条件化注入机制提供科学依据。

research_signals.title: 基于自然 Pass-rate 的条件式 Lesson 注入
research_signals.why_it_matters: 通过模型和评测任务级别的经验 pass-rate 数据动态决定是否注入 lessons，基于学术研究实现自适应上下文管理，有望提升 AI Agent 在不同任务类型上的整体表现。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex新增远程控制命令
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 `codex remote-control` 命令提供简化的无头远程控制入口点，以及线程分页 API，大幅提升大规模应用的灵活性与可扩展性

release_signals.title: Microsoft Agent Framework实现Magentic编排
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增实验性 Magentic Orchestration 编排方法，支持推理事件在 AGUI 中流转，标志微软在多智能体协作领域的重要探索

release_signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python沙箱安全边界变更
release_signals.why_it_matters: 沙箱本地源物化现在限制在 base_dir 内以关闭本地工件边界漏洞，这是需要迁移的 Breaking Change，影响所有使用沙箱的应用

release_signals.title: Opencode新增Scout研究代理
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 Scout 代理专门用于仓库研究、文档查找和依赖源检查，配合工作区同步功能，提升 AI 编程助手的上下文理解能力

release_signals.title: Claude TS SDK新增resolveSettings API
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 resolveSettings() (alpha) API 可在不启动 CLI 的情况下检查生效的合并配置，支持读取 MDM 配置（plist/HKLM/HKCU），提升 SDK 的可编程性

## Core

### Improvements

- Added HTTP API response compression for large non-streaming responses.
- Added the Scout agent for repo research, docs lookup, and dependency-source inspection.
- Added workspace sync so adapter-backed workspaces can be discovered and registered automatically.
- Added an interactive split-footer mode for `opencode run`.
- Simplified TUI keybinding config into a flat keybind format.
- Made duplicate worktree names fall back to the parent directory for clearer labels.

### Bugfixes

- Fixed HTTP API auth responses to match the previous wire format for empty authorize results and share errors.
- Returned structured validation errors from the HTTP API.
- Rejected invalid permission and question IDs in the HTTP API.
- Included auth challenges on typed HTTP API `401` responses.
- Fixed the HTTP API OpenAPI document route.
- Fixed detached sessions so they are claimed by the source project again.
- Forwarded `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM`, and `SIGHUP` correctly when running through the npm shim. (@chubes4)
- Allowed skills without descriptions to load correctly.
- Required auth on effect HTTP API root routes. (@RajvardhanPatil07)
- Kept tool ordering stable so tool lists stop reshuffling between runs.
- Made retry dialogs more specific to the provider and failure reason.
- Fixed Gemini reasoning controls so supported effort levels and small-mode defaults match the model.
- Fixed Anthropic Opus 4.5 reasoning effort options.
- Limited OpenAI deep research models to the reasoning level they actually support.
- Fixed GPT-5 reasoning variants so the exposed effort options match each model family.

## TUI

### Improvements

- Show retrying sessions as active in the project sidebar. (@edemaine)

### Bugfixes

- Fixed the sidebar message shown for language server state. (@Polo123456789)
- Sorted the session picker by full last-updated time instead of day buckets. (@Sleepful)
- Kept longer cleared prompts in draft history so they can be restored.

## Desktop

### Improvements

- Switched desktop updates to silent per-user install flow.

**Thank you to 5 community contributors:**
- @edemaine:
  - feat(desktop): working indicator on project sidebar (#26223)
- @RajvardhanPatil07:
  - fix(server): require auth for effect root routes (#26361)
- @chubes4:
  - fix(cli): forward signals from npm shim (#26259)
- @Sleepful:
  - fix(tui): sort session picker by full updated timestamp (#24725)
- @Polo123456789:
  - fix(sidebar): fix logic and missleading message #26469 (#26470)

key_changes: 新增 Scout agent：支持仓库研究、文档查找和依赖源检查
新增 HTTP API 响应压缩：对大型非流式响应进行压缩优化
新增工作区同步功能：自动发现和注册适配器支持的工作区
修复多项 HTTP API 问题：认证响应格式、OpenAPI 文档路由、权限验证等

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_FOR_OTEL` to re-enable the session quality survey for enterprises capturing responses through OpenTelemetry
- Added `settings.autoMode.hard_deny` for auto mode classifier rules that block unconditionally regardless of user intent or allow exceptions
- Fixed MCP servers configured in `.mcp.json`, plugins, and claude.ai connectors silently disappearing after `/clear` in the VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and Agent SDK
- Fixed a rare login loop where a concurrent credential write could overwrite a freshly-rotated OAuth token and force re-login
- Fixed MCP OAuth refresh tokens being lost when multiple servers refresh concurrently — users with several remote MCP servers should no longer need daily re-authentication
- Fixed an API error (400) when extended thinking emitted a redacted thinking block after a tool call
- Fixed `--resume` / `--continue` not finding sessions when the project path contains underscores
- Fixed plan mode not blocking file writes when a matching `Edit(...)` allow rule exists
- WSL2: image paste from Windows clipboard now works via a PowerShell fallback when xclip/wl-paste cannot read image data
- Fixed plugin `Stop`/`UserPromptSubmit` hooks failing when cache cleanup deletes a version still in use by a running session
- Improved visual consistency across slash command dialogs: standardized footer hints, dialog spacing, and arrow-key styling, and the dialog frame now appears immediately during loading instead of popping in after
- Fixed colors appearing at wrong positions in bash command output and markdown code blocks
- Fixed ReasonML diffs rendering corrupted "undefined" text artifacts at word-diff boundaries
- Fixed worktree exit dialog warning about uncommitted files in the wrong directory after worktree removal
- Fixed `@` file picker not matching files created mid-session in small non-git directories
- Fixed `@`-mention file picker not finding files in directories with more than 100 entries
- Fixed failed tool calls not being click-to-expand in fullscreen mode when their output was truncated
- Fixed Backspace and Ctrl+Backspace getting swapped after using Ctrl+G to open an external editor on terminals with persistent extended-key modes
- Fixed `/usage` weekly reset showing time of day instead of the calendar date
- Fixed welcome banner ellipsis causing column overflow on CJK terminals
- Fixed `/insights` crash when session history contains tool calls with malformed input fields
- Fixed a renderer crash when a tool's collapsibility classification changes mid-session
- Fixed a `skills` entry in `plugin.json` hiding the plugin's default `skills/` directory, and listing a file path now shows an error instead of failing silently
- Fixed IDE shell-integration lock files not respecting `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`
- Fixed trailing whitespace in copied terminal output during streaming
- Fixed plugin uninstall and enable/disable not matching slugs case-insensitively
- Fixed tool error truncation marker showing a negative count for surrogate-pair strings
- Fixed env vars from `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` SessionStart hooks going stale after `/resume` or `/clear`
- Fixed `/branch` saving a multi-line session title when given a pasted multi-line name
- Fixed a stray leading space on the second line of wrapped text at the column boundary
- Fixed Esc not dismissing dialogs in `/install-github-app`, `/desktop`, `/resume`, and `/web-setup`
- Fixed `/doctor` MCP schema errors not naming the missing field or showing the source file path
- Fixed Bash permission prompts showing an internal parser diagnostic instead of a user-readable explanation
- Fixed plugin slash commands with spaces (e.g. `/myplugin review`) not resolving to their namespaced form
- Fixed `AskUserQuestion` discarding multi-select answers when supplied as an array
- Fixed `/clear <name>` not labeling the cleared session for `/resume`
- Fixed `CronList` output missing qualifiers and the scheduled prompt
- Fixed "Jump to bottom" overlay leaving color artifacts on CJK characters in fullscreen mode
- Fixed wide markdown tables leaving a stale bordered render in terminal scrollback while streaming
- Fixed pasted text being silently dropped when a long prompt with a pasted-text placeholder was auto-truncated
- Fixed `/release-notes` getting stuck on an old version after a failed changelog refresh
- Fixed `/mcp` server list not scrolling when there are more servers than fit in the terminal
- Fixed mid-input slash command autocomplete not working after an initial slash command
- Fixed scrolling to bottom re-engaging auto-follow with `autoScrollEnabled: false`
- Fixed prompt suggestions being auto-submitted by Enter on an empty input instead of requiring Tab or arrow to accept
- Fixed keyboard shortcut hints not reflecting rebound keys from `keybindings.json`
- Fixed `/settings` language change being reverted on Escape after confirming
- Fixed `/terminal-setup` only appearing in autocomplete on exact name match instead of partial prefixes
- Fixed "Chat about this" on an `AskUserQuestion` dialog erasing the question text
- Fixed MCP tool results being invisible when the server returns content blocks
- Improved error message when `--worktree` collides with an existing or stale worktree
- Changed plugin marketplace removal key to `d` (matching delete elsewhere) instead of `r` which collided with retry

key_changes: 修复 MCP 服务器在 `/clear` 后消失的问题，涉及 VS Code、JetBrains 和 Agent SDK
修复 MCP OAuth refresh token 并发刷新丢失问题，减少远程 MCP 服务器每日重新认证
修复 `--resume`/`--continue` 在路径包含下划线时无法找到会话的问题

releases.author: seratch
releases.summary:
## Key Changes

### RealtimeAgent's default is now gpt-realtime-2

Since this version, the default model for RealtimeAgents is gpt-realtime-2: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime-2

### Sandbox local source materialization change

In this version, sandbox local source materialization keeps `LocalFile.src` and `LocalDir.src` within the materialization `base_dir` unless the source path is covered by `Manifest.extra_path_grants`. The `base_dir` is the SDK process current working directory when the manifest is applied; relative local sources are resolved from that directory, while absolute local sources must already be inside it or under an explicit grant. This closes a local artifact boundary issue, but it can affect applications that intentionally copy trusted host files or directories from outside that base directory into a sandbox workspace.Expand commentComment on line R24Resolved

To migrate, grant trusted host roots at the manifest level with `SandboxPathGrant`, preferably as read-only when the sandbox only needs to read those files:

```python
from pathlib import Path

from agents.sandbox import Manifest, SandboxPathGrant
from agents.sandbox.entries import Dir, LocalDir

# This is an absolute host path outside the SDK process base_dir.
TRUSTED_DOCS_ROOT = Path("/opt/my-app/docs")

manifest = Manifest(
    extra_path_grants=(
        # This host root is outside the SDK process base_dir, so the manifest must grant it.
        SandboxPathGrant(path=str(TRUSTED_DOCS_ROOT), read_only=True),
    ),
    entries={
        # No grant is needed for local sources that stay under the SDK process base_dir.
        "fixtures": LocalDir(src=Path("fixtures"), description="Local test fixtures."),
        # This entry reads from the granted host root and copies it into the sandbox workspace.
        "docs": LocalDir(src=TRUSTED_DOCS_ROOT, description="Trusted local documents."),
        # Dir creates a sandbox workspace directory; it does not read from the host filesystem.
        "output": Dir(description="Generated artifacts."),
    },
)
```

Treat `extra_path_grants` as trusted application configuration. Do not populate grants from model output or other untrusted manifest input unless your application has already approved those host paths.


## What's Changed

* feat: default realtime sessions to gpt-realtime-2 by @seratch in https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/3190
* fix: #3169 constrain local sandbox artifact sources to base dir by @seratch in https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/3177
* fix: Responses context-management extra_args collision by @alfozan in https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/3185

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

-   59530cf: fix(google): emit Vertex no-args streaming tool calls and preserve thoughtSignature

    Vertex emits a no-args function call as a single chunk shaped `{ functionCall: { name: 'X' } }` with no `args`, no `partialArgs`, and no `willContinue`. The streaming parser had no branch for this shape, so the call was dropped along with any `thoughtSignature` it carried. For Gemini 3 thinking models this caused the next multi-turn step to 400 with `missing thought_signature`. The unary (`doGenerate`) path had the same drop.

    Both paths now emit the call as a complete tool call with `'{}'` input and propagate `thoughtSignature` provider metadata.

    Fixes #14847.

key_changes: 修复 Vertex 流式传输中无参数函数调用被丢弃的问题
修复一元路径（doGenerate）无参数函数调用被丢弃的问题
确保 `thoughtSignature` 在所有调用路径中被正确传播
无参数调用现在以 `'{}'` 作为输入正确发出完整工具调用
解决了 Gemini 3 thinking models 多轮交互中的 missing thought_signature 错误
ai_summary.summary_cn: 修复了 @ai-sdk/google 在处理 Vertex 无参数函数调用时的关键问题。流式解析器和一元路径之前无法识别 `functionCall: { name: 'X' }` 这种无参数调用形状，导致调用和 `thoughtSignature` 被丢弃。对于使用 Gemini 3 thinking models 的多轮对话场景，这会引发 400 错误。现在已将无参数调用作为完整工具调用发出并正确传播 `thoughtSignature`。

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本期共发现 5 个跨仓库共性问题，影响范围最广的是「evaluator 级联删除导致跨数据集永久数据丢失」（54 个仓库），其次是「dev-only 依赖缺失导致 Bedrock Playground 启动崩溃」（18 个仓库）。高影响单仓问题集中在 Claude 系列 SDK 的 TTY 悬挂、认证令牌生命周期管理及插件 API 破坏性变更等方向。
global_highlights: **数据持久化缺陷**：deleteDatasetEvaluators / 并发 hook race condition / MCP 依赖 CVE 等问题均可能导致用户数据不可逆丢失或状态永久损坏，属最高优先级修复对象。
**认证/权限链路断裂**：从 OpenDevin 的登录 500、Claude Code 的 Keychain token 丢失、到 SDK 的短令牌不支持，多个仓库均存在身份验证状态管理缺陷，导致用户被意外登出或无法访问平台。
**启动/发布阻断性问题**：Bedrock 依赖缺失、TUI v1.14.42 崩溃、Claude Code Windows 安装失败等 P0 问题直接导致核心功能完全不可用，需紧急热修。
**插件/集成生态脆弱**：opencode 插件 API 无警告移除、Claude Plugins hookify 字段名不匹配、Agno CopilotKit 上下文丢失等问题表明各仓库在发布管理和生态兼容性验证上存在系统性短板。

top_pain_points.topic: deleteDatasetEvaluators cascades and permanently deletes shared built-in evaluator definitions across all datasets
top_pain_points.summary: The deleteDatasetEvaluators GraphQL mutation is supposed to remove only a single dataset's link to an evaluator. Instead, it deletes the underlying global Evaluator row, which cascades via FK to delete the global BuiltinEvaluator definition and every DatasetEvaluators row pointing to it across all datasets. Deleting a built-in from one dataset permanently removes that built-in from every other dataset that was using it — a silent, irreversible data destruction bug.

source_issues.title: deleteDatasetEvaluators deletes the underlying built-in evaluator, not just the dataset link
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction script confirmed: attaching same built-in to two datasets, then deleting from dataset A's link, results in the global built-in being deleted AND dataset B's link being cascade-deleted. Rows that existed before are permanently gone with no warning.

source_issues.title: deleteEvaluators returns mis-paired global ids and truncates duplicates
source_issues.evidence: Empirically confirmed via simulation across multiple rowid sets: response claims 'gid_1' was deleted when 'gid_2' was actually deleted (and vice versa). Also, duplicate input gids cause zip to stop early, making response shorter than input. No regression tests exist for this mutation.

source_issues.title: Playground: Anthropic invocation validation errors show as generic 'unexpected error'
source_issues.evidence: Server log shows ValidationError with exact human-readable message (e.g. 'The thinking budget must be less than max tokens.') but the subscription yields a hardcoded 'An unexpected error occurred' string. Root cause: invocation_parameters.to_orm() runs outside the inner try block, so validation errors are caught by the outer handler that replaces the message.

source_issues.title: Playground: surface View Trace (span) when a run errors for easier debugging
source_issues.evidence: RunMetadataFooter (which contains the View Trace link) is only rendered in the non-error branch of PlaygroundOutput.tsx. Even when a spanId is available after ChatCompletionSubscriptionResult, the error branch hides it. For pre-call failures, no span is ever persisted so nothing exists to link to.

top_pain_points.topic: Bedrock Playground crashes with ModuleNotFoundError on every run attempt
top_pain_points.summary: When users attempt to run any Bedrock model in the Prompt Playground, the app immediately crashes with ModuleNotFoundError for 'types_aiobotocore_bedrock_runtime'. The root cause is that two function-local imports of this dev-only package exist outside the TYPE_CHECKING guard in playground_clients.py, while the Dockerfile uses --no-dev, so the package is absent at runtime. This completely blocks the Bedrock playground use case for any self-hosted deployment.

signals.topic: Bedrock Playground crashes with ModuleNotFoundError on every run attempt
signals.summary: When users attempt to run any Bedrock model in the Prompt Playground, the app immediately crashes with ModuleNotFoundError for 'types_aiobotocore_bedrock_runtime'. The root cause is that two function-local imports of this dev-only package exist outside the TYPE_CHECKING guard in playground_clients.py, while the Dockerfile uses --no-dev, so the package is absent at runtime. This completely blocks the Bedrock playground use case for any self-hosted deployment.
signals.review_reason: This is a primary-flow blocker: every self-hosted user who tries to use Bedrock models in the Playground experiences a crash on every run attempt. The bug is reproduced with a clear repro case and root cause identified.

signals.topic: deleteDatasetEvaluators cascades and permanently deletes shared built-in evaluator definitions across all datasets
signals.summary: The deleteDatasetEvaluators GraphQL mutation is supposed to remove only a single dataset's link to an evaluator. Instead, it deletes the underlying global Evaluator row, which cascades via FK to delete the global BuiltinEvaluator definition and every DatasetEvaluators row pointing to it across all datasets. Deleting a built-in from one dataset permanently removes that built-in from every other dataset that was using it — a silent, irreversible data destruction bug.
aliases: Evaluator link deletion destroys global definition
signals.review_reason: This is a destructive data-loss bug that silently corrupts shared evaluator state across multiple datasets. Users lose globally shared configurations irreversibly. The bug has a fully confirmed reproduction script and clear root cause in the SQLAlchemy cascade delete path.

source_issues.title: deleteDatasetEvaluators deletes the underlying built-in evaluator, not just the dataset link

signals.topic: deleteEvaluators mutation API returns incorrect evaluator IDs — mis-pairs global IDs and silently truncates duplicates
signals.summary: The deleteEvaluators GraphQL mutation's response payload produces wrong (gid, rowid) pairings because it zips an unordered set against the original ordered input list. When built-in evaluators are filtered out, the response's evaluatorIds field lists global IDs that were NOT actually deleted. Additionally, duplicate input gids cause the response to be shorter than the input (zip stops at shorter iterable). Clients relying on the response to verify deletion results get silently incorrect data.
signals.review_reason: This corrupts the API contract for a core mutation endpoint. Any client using the response to verify deletion results receives incorrect data, leading to incorrect application state. The bug is empirically confirmed with a simulation script and has zero existing test coverage.

source_issues.title: deleteEvaluators returns mis-paired global ids and truncates duplicates
source_issues.evidence: Empirically confirmed via simulation across multiple rowid sets: response claims 'gid_1' was deleted when 'gid_2' was actually deleted (and vice versa). Also, duplicate input gids cause zip to stop early, making response shorter than input. No regression tests exist for this mutation.

signals.topic: Playground shows generic 'An unexpected error occurred' instead of actual validation failure message
signals.summary: When Anthropic invocation parameters fail server-side validation (e.g. thinking budget >= max_tokens), the Prompt Playground displays 'Chat completion failed: An unexpected error occurred' instead of the actual human-readable constraint that failed. The server logs the full Pydantic ValidationError but the client never receives it. Users cannot diagnose or correct invalid input configurations because the error is masked at the API boundary in the outer exception handler.
aliases: Generic subscription error masks validation failure reason
ValidationError details not propagated to Playground UI
signals.review_reason: This is a user-impacting UX defect: validation failures render the Playground unusable because users receive no actionable information about what went wrong. Users cannot correct their input, and the silent message replacement in the exception handler makes this a systemic pattern (not a single edge case). Marked P1 (not P0) because the underlying playground still functions for valid inputs.

source_issues.title: Playground: Anthropic invocation validation errors show as generic 'unexpected error'

Root cause: invocation_parameters.to_orm() runs outside the inner try block, so validation errors are caught by the outer handler that replaces the message.

This happens both for LLM-side failures (where a spanId exists but the error UI hides it) and for pre-call validation failures (where no span is persisted at all). Users experiencing playground errors have no in-product path to investigate root cause.
aliases: View Trace button missing in error state
Playground error UI lacks debugging affordance
signals.review_reason: This is a primary-flow UX failure that directly blocks users from diagnosing errors in a core debugging workflow. The View Trace affordance — the main diagnostic tool for playground failures — is architecturally hidden in the error state. Combined with PP-004 (generic error messages), users have no visibility into why their playground runs fail.

signals.topic: Context auto-expansion causes silent zero-response failures and session timeouts in autonomous/non-interactive mode
signals.summary: The `include_paths()` function auto-expands path tokens (backtick-wrapped or plain text with `/`) into full file content or directory listings. In autonomous mode, a single prompt referencing ~6 paths can balloon from ~50KB to 465KB. Weak models (grok-4.20, kimi-k2.6, codex:gpt-5.5) silently fail on oversized prompts — returning zero assistant messages, causing session timeouts and arm demotions in Thompson sampling. Observed 14–15% no_response rate on affected models.
signals.review_reason: This is a user pain point because it causes real, observable failures in autonomous/non-interactive mode: zero assistant responses and session timeouts on weak-context models. The 14–15% no_response rate on grok-4.20 and kimi-k2.6, plus the 465KB prompt bloat scenario, constitute concrete user impact evidence. It is not merely a security finding or passive telemetry gap — it actively breaks the main workflow for autonomous use cases.

source_issues.title: Add GPTME_DISABLE_PATH_INCLUDE env var for non-interactive prompts
source_issues.evidence: Concrete failure: autonomous Bob run on grok-4.20 had a ~50KB prompt explode to 465KB. Weak models silently fail on oversized prompts, returning zero assistant messages, session times out, scored as failed. Floor-streak counters trip; arms demoted in Thompson sampling.

source_issues.title: feat(context): add GPTME_DISABLE_PATH_INCLUDE env var to opt out of include_paths() expansion
source_issues.evidence: Zero-response failures observed on grok-4.20, kimi-k2.6: 14–15% no_response rate. Root cause: include_paths() auto-expansion in autonomous mode balloons prompts, causing model failures.

signals.topic: Shell truncation events produce no context-savings ledger entries, obscuring truncation regressions
signals.summary: When shell command output exceeds truncation thresholds (GPTME_SHELL_TRUNC_PRE_TOKENS + GPTME_SHELL_TRUNC_POST_TOKENS), the output is truncated but the truncation is not recorded in context-savings.jsonl. This occurs because the logdir ContextVar may not propagate in certain async contexts, causing save_large_output / record_context_savings to never fire. 23 truncation events observed in a single autonomous session with zero ledger entries and no tool-outputs/ directory.
signals.review_reason: This is a user-affecting issue: the lack of truncation ledger entries means context budget monitoring scripts (context-savings-health.py) produce misleading output and regressions in truncation behavior become invisible. While not a workflow-blocking crash, it degrades observability for autonomous operators who depend on context-savings.jsonl to understand where their context budget is consumed. The single-session count of 23 silent truncation events in a real workload demonstrates material impact on tooling reliability.

However, only 1 issue is present in the dataset, the bug is unconfirmed (bug-unconfirmed label), and the exact root cause is not yet identified (possible side-effect of tabby's file indexing), so it is classified as P2 rather than P0. The issue is retained because the user impact (data loss of unsaved work) is explicitly documented, even with a single report.

signals.topic: CopilotKit/AG-UI integration broken — missing conversation history causes infinite tool loops and context loss
signals.summary: When integrating Agno with CopilotKit via the AG-UI interface, the agent loses the full conversation history and only retains the last message. This causes two cascading failures: (1) tools registered with external_execution=true are triggered infinitely because each continue_run() call re-sends only the last message, creating a loop; (2) frontend context passed via run_input.context is silently dropped and never reaches Agent.arun(). Both block the entire CopilotKit integration from working.
signals.review_reason: 3 separate issues share the same root cause (AG-UI message history/context handling is broken in the adapter layer). The infinite loop in #7802 is a complete workflow blocker for CopilotKit users. #7801 prevents any frontend tool from being recognized. #7805 drops all frontend context. Together they make the entire AG-UI/CopilotKit integration unusable.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Tools with external_execution = true integrated with CopilotKit are triggered infinitely
source_issues.evidence: Agent keeps only the last sent message from AG-UI instead of full conversation history. CopilotKit triggers agent.continue_run() after each tool call. Without message history, the agent re-triggers with stale context, creating an infinite loop. This blocks the entire CopilotKit/AG-UI workflow.

source_issues.title: [Bug] AG-UI interface tools are not integrated with the Agent
source_issues.evidence: HTTP requests from AG-UI Interface declare frontend tools via CopilotKit packages, but run_agent does not extract these tools from the incoming HTTP request. The agent cannot recognize or use frontend tools.

source_issues.title: [Bug] AG-UI adapter receives context but does not pass run_input.context to Agent.arun()
source_issues.evidence: CopilotKit readable frontend context is received by the AG-UI adapter but silently dropped — it is never passed to Agent.arun() as run_input.context. Users cannot share frontend state with their agents.

signals.topic: Parallel tool hooks race condition corrupts run_context.messages, causing stale/broken state in concurrent execution
signals.summary: When multiple tool hooks execute in parallel via asyncio.gather (which Agno itself uses for parallel tool calls), the shared run_context.messages attribute is corrupted due to a non-thread-safe swap-restore pattern. Messages end up permanently pointing at a frozen shallow copy, breaking all subsequent LLM calls that rely on message history.
aliases: messages stale after parallel tool calls
signals.review_reason: Critical concurrency bug that directly affects Agno's own parallel tool execution path. When any hook awaits during parallel execution (a common pattern for DB logging, metrics, or approval hooks), message state is permanently corrupted, breaking the agent's core execution loop. This is a main-flow failure with severe user impact.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Parallel tool_hooks race in _safe_hook_call_async leaves run_context.messages permanently stale
source_issues.evidence: When tool hooks await (DB calls, logging, another LLM), the swap-restore on rc.messages interleaves across sibling coroutines. The finally clause from the last-responding hook overwrites rc.messages with a frozen shallow copy taken at the start of the gather batch. All subsequent LLM calls then operate on stale messages. Full reproduction steps and proof of concept provided.

signals.topic: CI failure in test_code_chunking due to tree_sitter_language_pack API change blocks all open PRs
signals.summary: The tree_sitter_language_pack package removed or renamed the SupportedLanguage export in a recent version, causing 11 unit tests to fail with ImportError. All PRs now show a failing CI check (tests 3.12), blocking merges for the entire contributor community.
signals.review_reason: CI infrastructure failure that blocks every open PR from being merged. While only 11 tests fail, the impact is universal — no contributor can get a green CI until this is resolved. This is a main-flow workflow blocker.

source_issues.title: [bug] CI test_code_chunking failures due to tree_sitter_language_pack API change
source_issues.evidence: All PRs show failing tests (3.12) check. 7536 tests pass but 11 tree-sitter tests fail with ImportError. This is blocking CI green status for all contributors.

signals.topic: aget_last_run_output() returns None when agent.id is auto-generated, losing run history
signals.summary: When an Agent is instantiated without an explicit id (relying on auto-generation), calling aget_last_run_output() or get_last_run_output() on that agent returns None even when the session contains matching runs. Users lose access to their run outputs and history.
aliases: auto-generated agent.id causes get_last_run_output to return None
run output lost with auto agent id
signals.review_reason: Users relying on the default auto-generated agent.id pattern silently lose all run output retrieval functionality. This breaks a core API contract (get_last_run_output should return outputs, not None) and affects anyone using the common default configuration.

source_issues.title: bug: aget_last_run_output returns None when agent.id is auto-generated during arun()
source_issues.evidence: Users who rely on auto-generated agent IDs (a common default pattern) cannot retrieve run outputs. Even though sessions contain runs with matching agent_id, querying returns None. Root cause identified in code, reproduction steps and proposed fix provided.

signals.topic: on_context_overflow handler fails to detect Anthropic context window errors, causing silent failures
signals.summary: Anthropic returns context window error messages in the format 'prompt is too long: X tokens > Y maximum', which does not match any pattern in ModelProviderError.CONTEXT_WINDOW_PATTERNS. As a result, the on_context_overflow handler never fires for Anthropic models, and users receive unhandled error responses instead of graceful overflow handling.
signals.review_reason: When Anthropic context windows are exceeded, the user's on_context_overflow callback never fires. This means any overflow handling strategy (truncation, summary, escalation) is bypassed, resulting in opaque error messages instead of graceful degradation. This breaks a key product feature for Anthropic users.

source_issues.title: bug: Anthropic context window errors not detected by CONTEXT_WINDOW_PATTERNS
source_issues.evidence: The on_context_overflow handler is completely bypassed for Anthropic model errors because Anthropic's error message format ('prompt is too long: X tokens > Y maximum') does not match any regex in CONTEXT_WINDOW_PATTERNS. Users expecting overflow handling get raw error responses instead.

signals.review_reason: Multiple distinct users report TUI crashing on startup after v1.14.42 upgrade, making the application completely unusable via its primary interface. The same version works fine for `opencode run` and `opencode web`, confirming this is a TUI-specific regression. Downgrading to v1.14.41 is the only workaround, meaning all users who auto-updated are blocked.

Users see their plugins vanish entirely from the sidebar — indistinguishable from uninstallation. source_issues.title: Plugin API: api.command.* removed in v1.14.42 with no deprecation cycle, no changelog entry, no migration guide

This is an internal null-pointer regression (inconsistent null-checking in the same function) that blocks core session access.

source_issues.title: Bug Report: TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating f.data.map) when entering certain sessions
source_issues.evidence: TUI crashes immediately when entering certain sessions with TypeError in session.sync. Root cause: messages.data!.map() with unsafe non-null assertion when API returns undefined for empty/malformed sessions. Makes affected sessions completely inaccessible. signals.topic: OAuth redirect loses order context — React StrictMode double-mount causes auth code double-use
signals.summary: After IAM login from Cart page, users are redirected to home page instead of back to Cart, losing the order context entirely. Root cause is React StrictMode double-mount triggering two concurrent code-exchange calls, the second failing and redirecting to home.
aliases: login redirects to home instead of cart
signals.review_reason: A production checkout flow is broken: users who try to submit an order are logged in successfully but lose their entire order context and are sent to the wrong page. This is a direct e-commerce workflow failure with clear user impact (orders cannot be completed in one session).

source_issues.title: fix(auth): Cart OAuth redirect loses post_auth_redirect after IAM login
source_issues.evidence: Cart checkout flow broken: clicking Submit redirects to IAM login, but after login users land on home page (/), losing /cart order context entirely. Root cause is React StrictMode double-mount: two concurrent exchangeCodeForToken calls, second fails (code already used), catches and redirects to / instead of /cart. Users must re-add items and submit again.

source_issues.title: /exit and /quit slash commands missing in autocomplete (v1.14.42)
source_issues.evidence: /exit and /quit not appearing in slash command autocomplete dropdown when typing / in prompt. Commands still exist and appear in Ctrl+P palette, but are not discoverable via the normal slash command UX. Regression from v1.14.42 keybinding refactor.

signals.topic: SDK panic on initialization when http.DefaultTransport is wrapped (otelhttp)
signals.summary: defaultHTTPClient() performs an unsafe type assertion on http.DefaultTransport, causing a panic when users wrap it with otelhttp.NewTransport. This breaks the widely-recommended OpenTelemetry global instrumentation pattern.
signals.review_reason: SDK panics on initialization, which is a startup-blocking crash. The panic is triggered by a widespread OTel community pattern (wrapping http.DefaultTransport globally for distributed tracing). Workarounds are non-trivial as they require abandoning the global-otel-instrumentation pattern or disabling env-based credential resolution. Introduced in v1.39.0 and still present in latest v1.41.0.

source_issues.title: panic: defaultHTTPClient does unsafe type assertion on http.DefaultTransport (breaks otelhttp wrapping)
source_issues.evidence: Panic occurs at client construction even when user provides a custom HTTP client via option.WithHTTPClient — the default client is built and panics before being discarded. Breaks the standard global OTel instrumentation pattern used across the Go ecosystem.

signals.topic: Build failure due to invopop/jsonschema version incompatibility (ordered-map type conflict)
signals.summary: SDK fails to compile when consuming module transitively requires invopop/jsonschema v0.14.0+, due to a switch in the ordered-map library dependency (wk8 vs pb33f).
signals.review_reason: Build failure is a workflow-blocking issue that prevents users from upgrading their dependencies. The incompatibility is triggered transitively — users may not directly use jsonschema but are blocked by their other dependencies. This forces users to manually pin older versions as a workaround, creating ongoing maintenance burden.

source_issues.title: Build failure: invopop/jsonschema v0.14.0 incompatibility (pb33f vs wk8 ordered-map type mismatch in schemautil.go)
source_issues.evidence: Go MVS selects the maximum version across the entire module graph. Any consumer project that directly or transitively requires invopop/jsonschema v0.14.0+ causes schemautil.go to fail compilation due to type mismatch between wk8/go-ordered-map and pb33f/ordered-map. The only workaround is manually pinning invopop/jsonschema to v0.13.0 in the consuming module.

signals.topic: Claude Code extension fails to load on Windows UNC/network paths — blocks entire extension

signals.review_reason: Main flow blocked: entire Claude Code extension fails to load on Windows UNC paths, the primary environment for corporate users. Full stack trace shows crash at extension startup. Workarounds exhausted.

source_issues.title: Claude Code Extension fails to load on network paths (UNC paths)
source_issues.evidence: Extension crashes with ENOENT error on UNC path open, all work blocked. Multiple workarounds (cache clear, reinstall) failed. Affects enterprise Windows users without admin rights to map drives.

signals.review_reason: Main flow blocked: extension completely non-functional after installation due to build artifact error. User forced to downgrade. Clear stack trace evidence.
